instruction: Schedule the system to update all installed packages automatically each day at 12:00 AM.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because it requires modifying system-level cron jobs and package manager settings that cannot be reliably verified in the OSWorld environment. The task involves system configuration that persists across reboots and requires administrative privileges that may not be properly testable.

llm_judge_reasons: Task is correctly marked as infeasible
Instruction requires configuring system-level cron jobs and package manager auto-updates, which cannot be reliably verified in OSWorld environment

Verification would require: (1) reading cron configuration files, (2) checking package manager settings, (3) simulating time to verify midnight execution, (4) confirming scheduled tasks execute correctly
System-level persistent configuration with time-based triggers exceeds OSWorld verification capabilities
The infeasible evaluator is the semantically correct choice for this type of task
